summary.intent: Fix callisto's self-release pipeline (0.8.0 never published) after a prior agent's mess, then clean up docs/branches and decide and execute roadmap items, notably consolidating 8 published crates into 4.
summary.outcome: Verified PR #104's checksum fix and found a P0 (empty has_artifacts from swallowed jq failure), refuted a false receipt-rename premise, merged docs cleanup (#151), deleted 173 stale branches, and rebased the crate consolidation PR #157 (8 to 4 crates) on top of the #156/#158 stack with all 1639 tests passing.

repo: Release workflow: a job with a skipped transitive ancestor is skipped unless its own if has a status function; policy script requires always() plus explicit needs.X.result checks on every job with needs.
`echo "x=$(cmd)"` under set -euo pipefail swallows cmd failure; assign in its own statement so set -e fires. Only one such instance existed in .github (callisto-release.yml:243).

Artifact name uniqueness in upload-artifact is scoped per run attempt, so run 34702634375 uploaded fixed-name release-intent in attempts 1-3 without conflict; the per-attempt receipt rename in #104 rests on a false premise.
Workspace version in Cargo.toml:6 is stale (0.3.3) and unused because no crate uses version.workspace = true.

Crate consolidation: callisto-format and vcs fold into callisto-model (MIT); conventional and changelog fold into callisto-graph; manifests and cli stay; callisto-core name is taken on crates.io by an unrelated project, so keep callisto-model.
Stack of PRs here is plain PR base chains (156 on main, 158 on 156, 157 on 158), not gh stack; retarget with gh pr edit.
Emoji rule in AGENTS.md is about superfluous emojis; severity markers in generated PR bodies are fine.
Bot PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN run no CI; the main ruleset has a merge queue but no required checks and CI lacks a merge_group trigger.
map_err_ignore clippy lint only catches |_|; 14 sites with |_err| remain in src/.

code.finding: has_artifacts is written via echo with an inline jq command substitution, so a jq failure yields an empty output and build-artifact/build/execute all skip while the run is green.

execute adds --artifact-manifest only if the manifest file exists, with no else branch; the assistant refuted the teammate's claim this silently degrades, citing Rust-side missing-artifact-inputs errors.
Policy rule and error string enforce run_attempt in the receipt artifact name based on a collision that cannot occur.
PR body generator adds red/yellow/green emoji severity markers in the Bump column; the user approved keeping them.

friction: The auto-mode classifier blocked local branch deletion twice even after user go-ahead.
GitHub token lacked the delete_repo scope, so the user had to delete the rehearsal repo.
Another Claude session ran an overlapping docs cleanup (#153, feat/docs-cleanup) that conflicted with #151's files.
Rebasing #157 onto #158 hit six code conflicts, resolved by keeping the stack's versions and re-applying the path rewrite.
The teammate hunter's finding 2 was circular and was retracted.
The PR description agent inserted a session link despite instructions not to.
open_items: P0 fix for has_artifacts (split assignment, case check for true/false, plus policy rule and mutant) was prototyped but not pushed to #104; it awaits user approval.
#104 still needs the owner's merge and the 0.8.0 recovery dispatch; the release must be verified end to end (registry, tags, GitHub Release, receipt).
Merge order: #156, #158, #157, with #113 (0.9.0) ideally after so it releases as 4 crates.
Publish a final release of each retired crate (format, vcs, conventional, changelog) with a README pointing to its new home.

Decisions still open: error-source gate build/drop (recommend build), default tag template (recommend drop), release-commit provenance ADR, rust-cache pin in orin-dx/actions, bot PR checks via merge_group, and #153 merge.
Token rotation deferred by the user; the empty release environment could be deleted.
AGENTS.md emoji rule could be reworded to 'no superfluous emojis'.
Unpublished 0.6.0 to 0.7.2 backfill and release notes for breaking changes remain undecided.
Stale plugin list in .claude/settings.json left for the owner.
Fixed-name artifact upload behavior on partial re-run (which release-intent download-artifact resolves) was not verified.
